note: Import Gate I4: no free text. venue_type describes WHO OPERATES the venue. It does not describe cost (fee_type) or who may enter (access_type), and it must never be used to derive either.

values.public_park: Outdoor courts in a municipal, county or state park, operated by a public parks authority.
values.community_center: Publicly operated indoor recreation or community facility.
values.dedicated_pickleball_facility: Purpose-built club or complex where pickleball is the primary sport.
values.racquet_club: Private tennis, squash or racquet club offering pickleball, membership-based.
values.fitness_center: Commercial gym or health club with courts, typically for members.
values.nonprofit_recreation: Nonprofit recreation operator such as a YMCA, JCC or Boys and Girls Club.
values.faith_facility: Gym or hall operated by a church, synagogue, mosque or other faith organisation.
values.residential_community: HOA, apartment, condominium or retirement community courts, for residents and their guests.
values.resort_hotel: Resort, hotel or campground courts, generally for guests.
values.entertainment_venue: Commercial venue pairing pickleball with food and drink.
